image_description: A large, white airship (dirigible) with red markings is docked inside a dimly lit hangar. The airship features an elongated, cigar-shaped envelope with a pointed nose and visible tail fins. A gondola structure is suspended beneath the forward section. There is prominent, illegible red text on the side of the hull and additional gibberish text in the upper left background.

The red paint does not sit naturally on the surface; it appears to have slight bleeding edges and inconsistent opacity, looking more like a texture overlay than physical paint.

The connection points between the gondola and the hull are vague and muddy. The mechanical details of the gondola itself are indistinct and lack rigid geometric definition, appearing slightly 'melted'.
The lines of the hangar floor and walls do not converge consistently, suggesting a slight warping of the 3D space around the subject.
